name: Image accordion 手风琴
notes:
/* THE ROW IS A FIXED WIDTH. Nothing here grows: the strip is
   340px whatever is happening inside it, so opening a picture
   is a negotiation rather than an expansion — every pixel the
   open one gains, the other four have paid for between them.
   That is why this is five grow numbers and not five widths.
   Flexbox does the arithmetic of who pays, at every gap, and
   it cannot be got wrong. */
.acc      { display: flex; width: 340px; height: 300px; overflow: hidden; }
.acc-cell { flex-basis: 0; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }
/* min-width: 0 is the one that bites — a flex item will not
   shrink below its content, and the content is an image. */

/* and the swell CARRIES. One panel wide and four narrow reads
   as a switch being thrown; a falloff reads as a force
   arriving somewhere. A gaussian on the distance in pictures,
   so the knob's two ends are two different components: tight,
   one picture opens; wide, the whole row leans. */
const fall = (d) => Math.exp(-((d / s) ** 2));   /* s: 0.35..1.25 */
flexGrow = 1 + lift * fall(Math.abs(i - open));  /* lift: 0.4..3.2 */

/* THE CORNER FOLLOWS THE GAP. A rounded picture against a
   rounded picture with no air between them shows a notch of
   page at every join, so capping the radius at the gap means
   there is no setting where a notch can appear.

   ONE number, and the strip takes it too. It kept a flat 12 of
   its own and clipped, which cut the first picture's left
   corners and the last one's right at a radius the three in
   the middle never saw — five pictures, three different
   corners. The cost of fixing it is that the band is square at
   Gap 0, which is the honest trade. */
const r = Math.min(12, gap);   /* the strip AND every picture */

/* and the crop re-frames rather than stretching. The height
   never changes and the pictures share a ratio, so the scale
   cover picks never changes either: widening a cell admits
   more photograph on each side and moves nothing that was
   already showing. */
.acc-cell img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
